title: Choose the visual world for BackupBinder
question: This roll ran with catalog challengers. The assigned world is Filing Cabinet Tab Index. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the category standard.

options.label: Filing Cabinet Tab Index
options.lineage: metal hanging-file cabinets and manila tab folders
options.thesis: Sites live as labeled folders in an open drawer — the page is the drawer, not a cloud dashboard.
options.viewport: Full-bleed open drawer; metal rails as nav; one open folder face holds BackupBinder, one headline, Get started; next hanging folder peeks as the section below.
options.risk: Can read as cute office kitsch if the metal and stamp discipline go soft.

raised.raise: Fixed kraft/metal/stamp palette with hard edges — no soft gradient wash left on a neutral template.
One dominant drawer composition owns the viewport; no equal feature-card row.
Drawer interior fills the first viewport as continuous material, not a framed mockup on white.
Trust facts sit as a cross-check strip on the folder face (last run / restore / destinations), not KPI cards.

options.label: Bank Passbook
options.lineage: stamped savings passbooks and teller ledgers
options.thesis: Every backup run stamps the passbook — trust is a ledger you can read line by line.
options.viewport: Open passbook spread: BackupBinder on the cover edge; stamped run rows; Get started as the teller stamp pad.
options.risk: Also the direction most trust-product runs land on.

options.label: Glazier Colorfield Partition
options.thesis: Backup steps and sites as glass panes in a black glazing grid — what matters lights cobalt.
options.viewport: Wall elevation as the page: brand and CTA in a lit cobalt pane; nav as labeled bays; next section a lower bay row.
options.case: Holds craft identification; one-pane-one-statement is clear — loses narrowly to filing for BackupBinder’s household-record metaphor.
options.risk: Reads architectural-portfolio when panes stay empty of product proof.

options.label: Toyism Signed Plate
options.thesis: Hard-edged shared symbols on a fixed cobalt-magenta-lemon palette.
options.case: Fuses poorly: backup operators do not identify with playful collective painting.
options.kept: Total palette commitment with no blending.

options.label: Variety Telop Field
options.thesis: Emotion-scaled outlined captions turn the frame into a live comic.
options.case: Fuses poorly: novelty crowds product clarity for restore trust.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale and weight, not soft cards.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Letters condense into words that reshape the ground.
options.case: Fuses poorly: surreal weather obscures the backup contract.

options.label: WebGL Shader Portal
options.thesis: A living shader fills the screen; thin type floats over pixels.
options.case: Fuses poorly: tech spectacle fights honest, claim-light positioning.

options.label: Night Flight Six-Pack
options.thesis: Six luminous gauges hold trust when nothing outside the glass is visible.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dial dashboards fight the anti-KPI product stance.
options.kept: Cross-check ritual — every trust fact shows trend, not a vanity number.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What backup-tool landings ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Brand, headline, CTA, then a row of equal feature cards — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
